# MovieVolume 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Movies](BlitzBasic-Movies)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
MovieVolume movie:Int32, volume:Float32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `movie` | Int32 | required | A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie). |
| `volume` | Float32 | required | The volume from 0 to 1. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets the volume of the sound of a movie, from 0 (silent) to 1 (the sound of the file, which is also the volume of a new movie). Values outside of that are brought to the nearest of the two. The volume stays when the movie is paused, stopped or sought. The picture is not affected. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals play a movie at the volume of the file.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
MovieVolume movie, 0.5   ; half as loud
```
